map.「【限时】点击领取你的专属优惠券！！！」—— 过长、3 个感叹号、含「领取/免费: "[Limited time] Click to claim your exclusive coupon!!!" - too long, three exclamation marks, claim and free type trigger words: high spam risk and a low predicted open rate.
map.「3 个技巧帮你本周完成季度目标」—— 长度适中、有具体利益点、无敏感词，预览即: "3 tips to hit your quarterly goal this week" - moderate length, a concrete benefit and no sensitive words, so the value is clear from the preview and the open rate is better.
map.标题里能加 emoji 吗？: Can emoji be used in a subject line?
map.少量、相关 emoji 可提升打开率，但堆砌或行业敏感（金融/医疗）反而易进垃圾: A few relevant emoji can lift open rates, but stacking them or using them in sensitive industries (finance / healthcare) tends to land in spam; run an A/B test instead.
map.评分能替代真实发送测试吗？: Can the score replace a real send test?
map.不能。评分只排查明显雷区，最终打开率仍要小流量 A/B 实测，受发送时间、列表质: No. The score only screens obvious pitfalls; the final open rate still needs a small-traffic A/B test and depends on send time and list quality.
